pages.text: The $(item)Lithium Blade$() is a steel sword with a burner. It is crafted from a Steel Sword, a Heavy Plate, aluminium sheets, a Spark Plug, a Circuit Board and copper wire.

$(l)Lighting it$()$(br)Carry a $(item)Lithium Charge$() (a plastic sheet, 3 lithium ingots and an aluminium sheet) and right-click with the blade. One charge is used and the blade lights for about $(item)100 seconds$(). It goes out by itself when the charge runs dry, and keeps its enchantments both ways.

$(l)While lit$()$(li)Every hit sets $(item)Hellfire$() on the target for 7 seconds, adding to any Hellfire it already has. Hellfire keeps the target burning for its whole duration. Each hit costs 2 durability.
$(li)Right-click to throw a fan of $(item)10 lithium sparks$(). They give Hellfire for 3 seconds but do not set blocks on fire. It costs 5 seconds of charge and has a 3 second cooldown.
